name: The Runner
description: A first-through who gets there. Fifteen, quickest through the Yards in four intakes, and the only one of the intake who passed the cold step without stopping to think about it.
narrative:
You are built for the part of the job that happens in corridors. You climb what
is not meant to be climbed, you carry people who cannot walk, and you have never
once been the slowest person in a room.

The instructors wrote the same note on you twice in two years: *goes first, and
works out why afterwards.* They did not mean it kindly and you have decided to
take it that way anyway.

powers.name: Life Support
boosts: Hard vacuum and hard cold, both (2 PP)
limits: External Power Source -- the pressure-skin, and it can be taken

powers.name: Enhanced Reactions
powers.knack: THE QUICK -- reflex past what a body should manage, and it surfaced early

powers.name: Durability
powers.knack: THE SET -- you take what should break you and get up

extras.charge: Power Points = POW 13; recovers 1 per minute of rest
extras.conditioning: Durability is trained, not worn -- it does not go in the locker with the suit
extras.fray: Raise crossings by one for every transit. A knack deepens as it climbs and so does the damage; they are one process. Landlocked is a long way off at this count, and the player should be told that once.

actor_notes: A PLAYABLE PRE-GEN. If the player chose this one, it is theirs -- never voice it, never decide what it notices (TABLE.md section 5). If they chose another, this one stays in the world as a fellow first-through in the same intake, run as an NPC, and should turn up at the Nine between missions.
